["Paper(title='Artificial Intelligence in Cybersecurity', authors=['Rushi Bhayani'], year=2025, abstract='Artificial Intelligence (AI) is radically reshaping cybersecurity by enabling data-driven threat analysis and response\\ncapabilities that far surpass traditional, signature-based methods. This\\nreview surveys how AI methods are integrated across security tools \u2013 from automated intrusion detection and malware analysis\\nto advanced threat intelligence platforms. We highlight recent advances (such as deep neural networks for pattern recognition,\\nreinforcement learning for adaptive defenses, and explainable AI for transparent alerts) and summarize how AI models are\\nevaluated (accuracy, false-positive rate, detection latency, etc.).
